Faculty & Labs

Alphabetical, by first name. (Bios are drafts — each prof should edit their own paragraph.)

   
Bowen Xu (bxu22@ncsu.edu) runs SoftMax: AI for software engineering — mining software repositories and building code intelligence tools that read, write, and review code.
John-Paul Ore (jwore@ncsu.edu) runs Robust Robots: the software side of robotics — finding and fixing the bugs (like physical-unit mismatches) that make real machines fail in the real world.
Katie Stolee (ktstolee@ncsu.edu) runs The Perspective People: how developers search, understand, and reuse code — and tools that do it better, from semantic code search to program repair.
Marcelo D’Amorim (mdamori@ncsu.edu) runs The Testable Team: software testing and reliability — systematic testing, debugging, and the fight against flaky tests.
Sandeep Kuttal (skuttal@ncsu.edu) runs the Human Factors + Experience Engineering Lab (HFXE): the human side of programming — how developers work, and how human-AI partnership can make them better.
Sarah Heckman (sarah_heckman@ncsu.edu) runs the Super SE Teaching Lab: computing education research — evidence-based ways to teach software engineering at scale.
Tim Menzies (timm@ieee.org) runs Irrational Research: frugal, explainable AI for software engineering — a good guess from a few dozen labels, plus the MOOT benchmark corpus.
Wesley Assunção (wguezas@ncsu.edu) runs The Evolve Group: how big software evolves — product lines, variability, and modernizing legacy systems.
